title: Security statement
description: What is implemented in the Montshire Media preview, and what still requires deployment verification.
body_html:
TRUST / IMPLEMENTATION STATUS

Security starts
with specifics.

This statement describes the current preview. It is not a certification, independent audit or guarantee.

What the preview does

The generated website serves static pages and self-hosted assets. The enquiry form is in preview mode and does not transmit form data. Optional analytics are withheld until consent; no measurement IDs are configured by default.

What the optional server implements

The supplied server validates field types, lengths, email and website formats, rejects unexpected fields and cross-origin requests, applies a honeypot and a persistent per-client request limit, and sends plain-text email over TLS when configured. It does not log enquiry bodies. The rate-limit store contains short-lived HMAC identifiers and timestamps, not raw IP addresses or enquiry contents.

What is not live or verified

The server is not provisioned on this static Sites deployment. Email delivery, production proxy settings, security headers, retention controls and abuse behaviour need deployment verification. No penetration test, SOC 2, ISO certification or independent security audit is claimed.

Reporting an issue

[Security contact: owner to supply before public launch.] Do not send secrets, exploit payloads or customer records through the general enquiry form.

title: Accessibility statement
description: Accessibility features and remaining verification work for the Montshire Media website.
body_html:
TRUST / ACCESSIBILITY

Useful means
usable.

We aim for WCAG 2.2 AA. Conformance has not been independently audited or certified.

Built into this version

Semantic page landmarks, one main heading per page, a skip link, native form labels, keyboard-operable menus and accordions, visible focus styles, status announcements, responsive layouts and reduced-motion support are implemented. Text stays available when JavaScript or animation support is absent.

Still to verify

Complete screen-reader testing, zoom and reflow checks, touch-target review, all colour combinations and third-party booking accessibility before public launch. Lighthouse scores and real-user Core Web Vitals have not yet been measured.

When something gets in the way

[Accessibility contact: owner to supply.] Include the page, the task you were trying to complete and the browser or assistive technology if you are comfortable sharing it.
